bio: A glass-fronted kitchen is the focal point of this smart monochrome restaurant that takes on a multitude of influences. The cooking exhibits flavours from a range of global cuisines, be that Polish, Mediterranean or Southeast Asian. Check the daily specials too, for luxurious produce like whole Alaskan king crab to share. Dishes have assured flavours, often accompanied by vibrant colours, and the excellent bread is a real highlight. Friendly service and spot-on wine recommendations complete the picture....
